audit.whatIsWrong: Four separate fields say Karma's Mantra-empowered Inner Flame ROOTS: whys[2] ('Mantra-empowered rooting Inner Flame'), whys[3] ('long-range RQ roots'), spikes[0].text ('RQ-empowered Inner Flame (Mantra) roots') and content early ('Mantra empowers Inner Flame into a long-range rooting nuke').
audit.why: Riot's own text for Inner Flame says the Mantra bonus 'creates a cataclysm which deals damage after a short delay' — damage, no root. The root in Karma's kit is Focused Resolve (W), whose Mantra bonus heals her and EXTENDS the root. The page has the root attached to the wrong ability, which changes how a player dodges it.
audit.corrected: Mantra-Q rewritten as a delayed cataclysm; the root kept where it belongs, on the 675-range Focused Resolve tether.
sources: enemyKit Q and W Riot text

audit.whatIsWrong: All seven phases[N].side read 'Skill' while content win[0..6] reads Karma, Karma, Karma, Karma, Neeko, Neeko, Neeko and the packet levelChart says exactly the same. Two layers, two different answers to 'who wins Level 1'.
audit.why: phases[N].side and win[N] are one row. The whys under the Skill rows also described Neeko dominating stages the content layer gives to Karma.
audit.corrected: phases[0..3].side to Karma and phases[4..6].side to Neeko, matching win[N] exactly, with all seven whys rewritten in the same proposal so each explains the verdict above it.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spike language was generic ('level 6 adds the ambush') and never named the cooldown the flip actually runs on.
audit.why: Mantra is 40/38/36/34s, free at level 1, and Gathering Fire shortens it every time a damaging ability lands — so the level 6 window is defined by whether Mantra is spent, not by the clock.
audit.corrected: Spike and cooldown fields rewritten around the 40s Mantra and Gathering Fire's refund.
sources: enemyKit R cd 40/38/36/34 and Riot text

audit.why: champ-gender lists karma as female; the owner is 'you', so every third-person pronoun is Karma.

notes: Biggest correction here is the misplaced root: four fields attributed a root to Mantra-empowered Inner Flame. Riot's text gives Mantra-Q a delayed cataclysm and puts the root on Focused Resolve (W), whose Mantra bonus heals her and extends the root. Chart pairs: phases[N].side was 'Skill' on all seven rows while win[N] and the packet levelChart both read Karma x4 then Neeko x3 — sides moved to match win[N] exactly and every why rewritten in the same proposal. Ratings (5/10 x4, 6/10 x3) and tone '#e8b84b' left alone; diff EVEN at 5.5/10 still fits a 55.49% win rate over 319 games. Karma's W carries a revealsStealth flag; Neeko's disguise is not stealth in Riot's text, so I did not claim Focused Resolve reveals through it — that is a genuine unknown and someone should confirm whether the tether can be cast on a disguised Neeko. Mechanical lint pass (tools/matchup-lint.js). MISGENDER: the enemy is female and the full layer addressed her as male; every flagged field corrected in place. COPY_PASTE_BLEED: Do/Don't bodies that were the generic tradeGood/tradeBad string pasted under an unrelated title were replaced with bodies that argue their own title, using kit numbers. COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT / UNSUPPORTED_MAGNITUDE: rebuilt around real cooldowns and ranges from champ-data/_kits.
